item.title: Nirvana's "Smells Like Teen Spirit" Surpasses 2 Billion YouTube Views
item.description: Nirvana’s “Smells Like Teen Spirit” has now passed the 2-billion view mark on YouTube. After first being uploaded in 2009, the video quietly amassed its first billion by 2019.
